The '''Black Envy''' was a [[Computer virus/Legends|computer virus]] developed by the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:WtA" /> It was used against [[Car'das/Legends|Car'das]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] during the [[Battle of Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Battle of Tansarii Point Station]].<ref name="SWG:PM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Precise Maneuvers|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref>
